about:
# GuildForge

**Your guild's professions, all in one place.** GuildForge shares every member's profession skills and known recipes over guild addon chat, so you can see who can craft what, what it takes to make it, and whether you already have the mats — without spamming guild chat.

Built for **WoW Forever**, and also works on **Classic Era**.

![Guild Home](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TheFrosty02/GuildForge/main/docs/screenshots/home.png)

## Features

### Guild Home
The window opens on **Home**, the guild's crafting hub at a glance:

- **Guild news**: who reached a new skill milestone (every 25 points), took up a profession, learned a recipe (flagged when they're the first in the guild), or finished a request. Shift-click a recipe in the news to link it.
- **Online with GuildForge**: who's on right now, with their professions.
- **Requests you can make**, **cooldowns ready**, and your **Request Board** and **Shopping List** at a glance (click either to open it).

Typing in the search box from Home searches the whole guild, like the All tab.

### Request board
Need something crafted when nobody who can make it is online? Expand the recipe and click **Request**, pick how many you need (up to 99), and add a note if you like ("have mats", "tip 5g"). It goes on the guild's **Request Board** (the note tab at the bottom of the tabs):

- Guildmates who know the recipe see it under **You can make**, get a chat line when it's posted, and see a count on the minimap button.
- **I'll make it** whispers you and marks it as taken for everyone, so two people don't both craft it.
- Once you have it, click **Done**: it comes off every board and the crafter gets the credit in guild news. **Cancel** takes it down without that.
- Up to 5 open requests each; they close on their own after 3 days. Guildmates who log in later catch up on the board.

![Request Board](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TheFrosty02/GuildForge/main/docs/screenshots/requests.png)

### Every profession at a glance
The **All** tab lists each profession with how many guildmates have it, how many recipes are shared, and the top crafter. Profession tabs run down the right side of the window, spellbook style, with their icons — professions nobody in the guild has yet are greyed out.

![Guild Professions overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TheFrosty02/GuildForge/main/docs/screenshots/overview.png)

### Crafters, ranked and live
Open a profession to see every guildmate who has it, ranked by skill with a color-coded bar (Apprentice, Journeyman, Expert, Artisan). A green dot means they're online right now; offline crafters show when they were last seen. Click a crafter to show only their recipes.

![Alchemy tab with crafters and recipes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TheFrosty02/GuildForge/main/docs/screenshots/profession.png)

### Recipes with reagents and your mat counts
Every known recipe shows its icon, item-quality color, who can craft it, and whether **you** have the mats in your bags (`Mats ready x17`). Click a recipe to expand it and see each reagent with what you have against what's needed, plus anything sitting in your bank.

- **Ask a crafter** — one click whispers the best online crafter with the item link and the mats you already have.
- **Add to list** — queue it on your shopping list.
- **Shift-click** any recipe or reagent to link it in chat; hover for the full item tooltip.

![Expanded recipe with reagents and actions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TheFrosty02/GuildForge/main/docs/screenshots/recipe.png)

### Shopping list
Collect the recipes you plan to make and GuildForge combines them into one list of materials, showing what you've gathered and how many more you need. The same "need 4 more" note appears on item tooltips everywhere — bags, vendors and the auction house.

![Shopping list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TheFrosty02/GuildForge/main/docs/screenshots/shopping-list.png)

### Guild bank materials (with Guild Bank Toons)
If your guild uses the [Guild Bank Toons](https://github.com/kota150/GuildBankToons) addon, GuildForge works with it; without it, none of this shows.

- **Guild bank stock** next to your own counts on every reagent line (`Guild bank: 120`).
- **Get mats from guild bank** on an expanded recipe (and on the Shopping List, for every material still needed) asks the bank for what your bags are missing. A recipe on your shopping list asks for that many crafts.
- **Craft order via guild bank** on a recipe you can't make: the bank mails the missing materials to the crafter, who is told to craft it and mail it to you, and GuildForge whispers them as **Ask a crafter** does.
- Requests wait for a bank officer's approval in Guild Bank Toons. Chat lists what was requested and anything the bank couldn't cover; the buttons are greyed out when the bank has none of it.

### And more
- **Search** recipes, crafters, professions and reagents (try "linen") across the whole guild, plus a **Have mats** filter for things you can craft right now.
- **Item tooltips** show which guildmates craft an item and which recipes use it.
- **Cooldowns** — Mooncloth, transmutes and the Salt Shaker are tracked and shared, so the guild can see who's ready.
- **Not known in guild** — recipes seen at trainers that nobody in the guild has learned yet, with the skill they require. Anyone's trainer visits fill in the list for the whole guild.
- **Minimap button** — a "GF" bubble with a badge counting guildmates online with GuildForge. Left-click to open, right-click to sync, drag to move.
- **Update notice** — when a guildmate has a newer GuildForge, you're told once per session and the window's footer shows it.
- **Any game language** — professions are recognised on Spanish, German and other clients, and guildmates' recipes show in your language when they're on 1.2.2 or later. GuildForge's own buttons and messages are still in English.
- **Light on guild chat** — syncs send a short fingerprint of each recipe list, and guildmates only download lists that changed. Lists travel as recipe IDs, about half the messages of names, and learning a recipe sends just that change.

### Settings
Click the gear next to **Sync** to toggle the minimap button, item tooltips, syncing on login and quiet mode, adjust the window scale, or re-share all of your recipes. If your data ever looks wrong, **Clear my data** forgets everything you've received from guildmates (keeping your own professions) and downloads it fresh.

![Settings panel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TheFrosty02/GuildForge/main/docs/screenshots/settings.png)

## Installation

1. Install from CurseForge, or download this repository and put the `GuildForge` folder in your AddOns folder:
   - WoW Forever: `World of Warcraft/_forever_/Interface/AddOns/GuildForge`
   - Classic Era: `World of Warcraft/_classic_era_/Interface/AddOns/GuildForge`
2. Make sure the folder contains `GuildForge.toc` and `GuildForge.lua`.
3. Restart the game (or `/reload`) and enable GuildForge on the character select AddOns screen.

## Getting started

1. Open each of your professions once (for example your First Aid or Leatherworking window). GuildForge scans the recipes you know and shares them with the guild.
2. Visit profession trainers to fill in the **Not known in guild** lists.
3. Click the **GF** minimap button or type `/guildforge` to open the window.

Your guildmates need GuildForge too — the more people running it, the more complete the guild's list gets.

## Slash commands

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `/guildforge` | Open or close the window (also `/gf`, `/gforge`, `/guildprof`, and the old `/guildcraft`) |
| `/guildforge sync` | Ask the guild for any changed professions and recipes |
| `/guildforge push` | Re-share all of your recipes in full |
| `/guildforge refresh` | Rescan your own professions |
| `/guildforge settings` | Open the settings panel |
| `/guildforge home` | Open the Home tab |
| `/guildforge requests` | Open the Request Board |
| `/guildforge minimap` | Show or hide the minimap button |
| `/guildforge clear` | Forget received guild data and download it again fresh |
| `/guildforge who` | List guildmates online with GuildForge and their versions |
| `/guildforge status` | Print sync counters |
| `/guildforge log` | Open the live message log (also in Settings), with Copy for bug reports |
| `/guildforge debug` | Print how your name, the roster and recent messages are read |
| `/guildforge scan` | With a profession window open: show what GuildForge can read from it, and save your recipes |

## Discord bot

The bot in [`companion/`](https://github.com/TheFrosty02/GuildForge/blob/main/companion) brings GuildForge to your guild's Discord:

- **A leaderboard that's always there.** One message in a channel of your choice lists the top crafters of every profession with their skill and recipe count. The bot edits that same message whenever the data changes, so it never piles up new posts.
- **`/levels [character]`**: one character's professions with progress bars, or everyone's levels.
- **`/crafts character [profession] [search]`**: what a character can craft, optionally one profession or recipes containing a word. Character and profession names autocomplete.
- **`/leaderboard [profession]`**: the leaderboard, or a full ranking for one profession.
- **`/requests [profession]`**: open requests from GuildForge's request board, with who's on each one.
- **Guild news in a channel** (optional, `news_channel_id`): skill milestones, newly learned recipes and finished requests, posted as they're saved. The first run only marks where to start, so it doesn't post the backlog.

Answers are only visible to the person who asked (or sent to them by DM with `reply_in_dm`), nothing shows in the channel for anyone else, and each answer is deleted after `delete_after` seconds (5 minutes by default, at most 14).

### Who runs it

WoW addons can't reach the internet, so the bot reads the data GuildForge saves on the PC it runs on (`SavedVariables/GuildForge.lua`), which the game writes when you **log out or `/reload`**. So:

- **One person runs it**: usually an officer who plays often. Nobody else needs anything besides GuildForge itself; guildmates just use the commands in Discord.
- It runs on **the same PC that plays WoW** with GuildForge, signed in to a character in the guild. That game collects everyone's professions from guild chat while it's online; the bot picks them up at the next logout or `/reload` and updates the leaderboard within seconds.
- The bot only answers while the script is running. Leave it running while you play, or on a PC that stays on (it still needs WoW and GuildForge on that PC for fresh data).

### Setting it up

1. **Make the bot** at [https://discord.com/developers/applications](https://discord.com/developers/applications) → **New Application** (name it GuildForge) → **Bot** → **Reset Token** and copy the token. Keep it secret: anyone with it controls the bot. No privileged intents are needed.
2. **Invite it**: **OAuth2** → **URL Generator** → scopes `bot` and `applications.commands`; bot permissions **View Channels**, **Send Messages**, **Embed Links** and **Read Message History**. Open the generated link and pick your server.
3. **Get the IDs**: in Discord, **User Settings → Advanced → Developer Mode** on, then right-click your server → **Copy Server ID**, and right-click the leaderboard channel → **Copy Channel ID** (and the news channel, if you want one).
4. **Install Python 3.8 or newer** (python.org; on Windows tick *Add python.exe to PATH*), then in the `companion` folder:
   ```
   pip install -r requirements.txt
   ```
5. **Settings**: copy `guildforge_discord.example.json` to `guildforge_discord.json` and fill in `token`, `server_id`, `leaderboard_channel_id`, `news_channel_id` (or leave it empty for no news posts) and `wow_dir` (your World of Warcraft folder, for example `C:/Program Files (x86)/World of Warcraft`). That file is git-ignored.
6. **Check it** without touching Discord; this prints the leaderboard and sample answers from your saved data:
   ```
   python3 guildforge_discord.py --dry-run
   ```
7. **Run it**:
   ```
   python3 guildforge_discord.py
   ```
   It posts the leaderboard and the commands appear in your server right away. Keep the window open; close it to stop the bot.

Other settings: `guild` (if your saved data has more than one guild), `account` (if several WoW accounts play on that PC; by default every account's data is merged, newest first), `top` (crafters per profession on the leaderboard, default 5), `delete_after`, `reply_in_dm`, and `interval` (how often to check for a new save, in seconds). On Windows use `python` instead of `python3`.

## Compatibility

- **WoW Forever** (`GuildForge_Forever.toc`, interface 16001 from the beta) is the main target. GuildForge reads recipes from Forever's profession window, appears in the minimap addon menu and in Esc → Options → AddOns, supports first and last names, and holds guild messages while the game blocks addon chat (for example in combat in instances), sending them afterwards. If Forever launches with a different interface number, update the TOC.
- **Classic Era** (`GuildForge_Vanilla.toc`, interface 11509) runs from the same files.
- Guildmates on older GuildForge versions still sync with newer ones; they just won't see reagent details, cooldowns or the faster summary syncing until they update.

## Releasing

Pushing a version tag builds `GuildForge.zip` with the [BigWigs packager](https://github.com/BigWigsMods/packager) and publishes it (see `.github/workflows/release.yml`):

```
git tag v1.0.0
git push origin v1.0.0
```

The tag becomes the addon's version, and the matching `CHANGELOG.md` section becomes the release notes. The ZIP is always attached to a GitHub release; it's also uploaded to CurseForge once the repository has a `CF_API_KEY` secret and the TOC files have `## X-Curse-Project-ID`. `CURSEFORGE.md` holds the project page description.

## Testing

`tests/run_tests.py` runs GuildForge in a stand-in WoW environment with WoW's Lua version. It checks that the addon loads and opens, that two players sync (including realms with punctuation and late logins), that trainer rank upgrades aren't saved, and the Guild Bank Toons integration against a stub of its API (hidden without a bank, stock shown, missing amounts requested, craft orders sent to the crafter):

```
python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install lupa
.venv/bin/python tests/run_tests.py
```

## Credits

Created by TheFrosty02, with UI and feature work by kota150.

# Changelog

All notable changes to GuildForge are listed here.

## [1.3.0] - 2026-11-23

Thanks to **Vichaoss** for the fixes in this release.

### Changed
- **Recipe lists travel as recipe IDs instead of names.** Each guildmate's game names them in their own language, so there's nothing to translate, and a full list takes about half the messages (a 60-recipe list: 10 instead of 21).
- **Learning a recipe sends just that change**: one or two messages instead of the whole list (about 20). A guildmate who missed it, or holds an older list, downloads the whole list as before.
- The first time you log in on this version, guildmates' lists download once in the new format.
- `/gf scan` also lists the skills it didn't count as professions.

### Note
- **Guildmates on 1.2.x keep syncing** with you: they still get lists by name, both when they ask and when your list changes while they're online. The update notice from 1.2.3 tells them a new version is out.
- The Discord bot needs no changes: it still reads recipe names.

### Fixed
- **A profession's skill showed as 0 / 0** for a guildmate whose recipes for it were shared. This happened when GuildForge didn't recognise that profession in their skill list, for example a client in another language naming it differently from its spell and window (Cooking on a Spanish client). Their recipe list was also deleted and sent again over and over. Opening that profession's window now fixes it, and it's remembered for later logins. A crafter whose skill wasn't shared shows **?** instead of 0 / 0.
- **Opening a profession could raise a Lua error** ("attempt to index field 'info'"), and **Not known in guild** could show a code like `i250486` instead of a recipe name. This happened since 1.2.3 with a recipe seen under names in two languages whose item the game hadn't loaded yet. Such a recipe is now listed under one of its names.

## [1.2.3] - 2026-11-20

### Added
- **Update notice.** When a guildmate is on a newer GuildForge, you're told once per session in chat, and the bottom of the window shows the new version until you update. Test and development builds never prompt.

### Fixed
- **Trainer recipes, requests and cooldowns across languages.** 1.2.2 brought professions and recipes to every game language; these three still went by name, so a guild mixing languages saw them twice or not at all:
  - A recipe seen at a trainer in another language no longer shows under **Not known in guild** when a guildmate knows it, and one seen at trainers in two languages is listed once, in yours.
  - Requests show in your language, and you're told you can make one even when it was posted in another. (The requester needs 1.2.3 for this.)
  - Cooldowns (Mooncloth, transmutes, Salt Shaker) are shared under one name and shown in yours. On non-English clients, transmutes are now grouped into one entry, as on English ones.

## [1.2.2] - 2026-11-20

Thanks to **Vichaoss** for this release.

### Fixed
- **GuildForge didn't see your professions on a game client in another language** ([#3](https://github.com/TheFrosty02/GuildForge/issues/3)). It only knew the English profession names, so on a Spanish, German or other client it found no professions and shared no recipes. It now recognises professions in every language, and they reach the guild under the same names for everyone.
- On a client in another language, profession ranks bought from a trainer ("Oficial", "Geselle") were saved and shared as recipes, and the crafter tooltip always showed the rank in English. Rank names now come from the game, in your language.
- A recipe list could be sent over and over: a guildmate who checked your list while it was still on its way asked for it again once it had arrived, which started another round. GuildForge now waits for a list that's arriving and skips a request it has just answered.
- Recipes from one profession could also be saved under another (Enchanting under Tailoring) on a client in another language. Opening the profession removes the copy, and guildmates drop it too.

### Changed
- **Guildmates' recipes show in your language**, when they're on 1.2.2 too and have opened that profession since updating. Trainer recipes, cooldowns and requests are still in the language of whoever shared them.
- `/gf scan` also shows your game's language and the professions GuildForge found.

## [1.2.1] - 2026-11-14

### Added
- **Request an amount**: **Request** now opens a small window where you choose how many you need (1 to 99, with − and + buttons) as well as the optional note. It starts at the count on your shopping list, if the recipe is on it. Guildmates on 1.2.0 see the amount too.

### Fixed
- **"Recipe scan … showed fewer recipes than saved" after every craft.** When the profession window shows fewer recipes than you have saved (usually a filter like Have Materials), GuildForge keeps your saved list and says so, but crafting rescans the window, so the message came back with every craft. It now shows once per profession per session, with the counts (the message log still records each one).
- A search left in the box turned Home and All into search results when you went back to them. Clicking a tab now clears the search box.

## [1.2.0] - 2026-11-14

### Added
- **Guild Home**: the window now opens on a Home tab with guild news, who's online with GuildForge and their professions, requests you can make, cooldowns that are ready, and your Request Board and Shopping List at a glance. Searching from Home searches the whole guild.
- **Guild news**: skill milestones (every 25 points), professions taken up, newly learned recipes (marked when they're the first in the guild) and finished requests, worked out from what guildmates already share. A leveling spree within a few hours stays one line. Nothing shows for data you're only catching up on.
- **Request board**: expand a recipe and click **Request** (with an optional note) to ask the guild for it, even when no crafter is online. Guildmates who know the recipe see it under **You can make**, in chat and on the minimap button tooltip; **I'll make it** whispers you and marks it taken for everyone. **Done** takes it down and credits the crafter in guild news. Up to 5 open requests each, closed after 3 days; late logins catch up. `/gf home` and `/gf requests` open the new tabs.
- **Discord bot**: `/requests` lists the request board, and guild news can be posted to a channel (`news_channel_id`).

### Changed
- **Recipes are sorted by skill level**, lowest first, instead of alphabetically. WoW Forever gives the skill where a recipe turns gray, so that's the level used (or the trainer's required skill when that's all GuildForge knows). Each player's levels reach the guild the next time they open that profession; until then their recipes sort last.
- The profession tabs down the side of the window sit a little higher.
- **A calmer window.** Less on screen, nothing removed:
  - **Refresh** and **Sync Guild** are now one **Sync** button.
  - The title area is no longer a second bordered box, so the list gets more room.
  - The bottom bar shows just your guild (and anything still being shared). The sync counters are still in `/gf status`.
  - Recipes only call out **Mats ready**. The red **Missing mats** on nearly every row is gone, and so are the **+** buttons: click anywhere on a recipe to expand it, and an open one stays highlighted.
  - Crafters lose the rank numbers (the list is already in order) and the **Online** text next to the green dot.
  - The All tab and Home use flat rows instead of a bordered box for each profession.
  - Counts read "5" instead of "5 of 5" unless a search or filter is hiding some, and "0 you can craft now" is left out.
- Home's **Online with GuildForge** list shows main professions only, leaving out Cooking, First Aid and Fishing.

### Note
- Guildmates on older versions keep syncing as before, but don't see or answer requests until they update.

# Changelog

All notable changes to GuildForge are listed here.

## [1.2.2] - 2026-11-20

Thanks to **Vichaoss** for this release.

### Fixed
- **GuildForge didn't see your professions on a game client in another language** ([#3](https://github.com/TheFrosty02/GuildForge/issues/3)). It only knew the English profession names, so on a Spanish, German or other client it found no professions and shared no recipes. It now recognises professions in every language, and they reach the guild under the same names for everyone.
- On a client in another language, profession ranks bought from a trainer ("Oficial", "Geselle") were saved and shared as recipes, and the crafter tooltip always showed the rank in English. Rank names now come from the game, in your language.
- A recipe list could be sent over and over: a guildmate who checked your list while it was still on its way asked for it again once it had arrived, which started another round. GuildForge now waits for a list that's arriving and skips a request it has just answered.
- Recipes from one profession could also be saved under another (Enchanting under Tailoring) on a client in another language. Opening the profession removes the copy, and guildmates drop it too.

### Changed
- **Guildmates' recipes show in your language**, when they're on 1.2.2 too and have opened that profession since updating. Trainer recipes, cooldowns and requests are still in the language of whoever shared them.
- `/gf scan` also shows your game's language and the professions GuildForge found.

## [1.2.1] - 2026-11-14

### Added
- **Request an amount**: **Request** now opens a small window where you choose how many you need (1 to 99, with − and + buttons) as well as the optional note. It starts at the count on your shopping list, if the recipe is on it. Guildmates on 1.2.0 see the amount too.

### Fixed
- **"Recipe scan … showed fewer recipes than saved" after every craft.** When the profession window shows fewer recipes than you have saved (usually a filter like Have Materials), GuildForge keeps your saved list and says so, but crafting rescans the window, so the message came back with every craft. It now shows once per profession per session, with the counts (the message log still records each one).
- A search left in the box turned Home and All into search results when you went back to them. Clicking a tab now clears the search box.

## [1.2.0] - 2026-11-14

### Added
- **Guild Home**: the window now opens on a Home tab with guild news, who's online with GuildForge and their professions, requests you can make, cooldowns that are ready, and your Request Board and Shopping List at a glance. Searching from Home searches the whole guild.
- **Guild news**: skill milestones (every 25 points), professions taken up, newly learned recipes (marked when they're the first in the guild) and finished requests, worked out from what guildmates already share. A leveling spree within a few hours stays one line. Nothing shows for data you're only catching up on.
- **Request board**: expand a recipe and click **Request** (with an optional note) to ask the guild for it, even when no crafter is online. Guildmates who know the recipe see it under **You can make**, in chat and on the minimap button tooltip; **I'll make it** whispers you and marks it taken for everyone. **Done** takes it down and credits the crafter in guild news. Up to 5 open requests each, closed after 3 days; late logins catch up. `/gf home` and `/gf requests` open the new tabs.
- **Discord bot**: `/requests` lists the request board, and guild news can be posted to a channel (`news_channel_id`).

### Changed
- **Recipes are sorted by skill level**, lowest first, instead of alphabetically. WoW Forever gives the skill where a recipe turns gray, so that's the level used (or the trainer's required skill when that's all GuildForge knows). Each player's levels reach the guild the next time they open that profession; until then their recipes sort last.
- The profession tabs down the side of the window sit a little higher.
- **A calmer window.** Less on screen, nothing removed:
  - **Refresh** and **Sync Guild** are now one **Sync** button.
  - The title area is no longer a second bordered box, so the list gets more room.
  - The bottom bar shows just your guild (and anything still being shared). The sync counters are still in `/gf status`.
  - Recipes only call out **Mats ready**. The red **Missing mats** on nearly every row is gone, and so are the **+** buttons: click anywhere on a recipe to expand it, and an open one stays highlighted.
  - Crafters lose the rank numbers (the list is already in order) and the **Online** text next to the green dot.
  - The All tab and Home use flat rows instead of a bordered box for each profession.
  - Counts read "5" instead of "5 of 5" unless a search or filter is hiding some, and "0 you can craft now" is left out.
- Home's **Online with GuildForge** list shows main professions only, leaving out Cooking, First Aid and Fishing.

### Note
- Guildmates on older versions keep syncing as before, but don't see or answer requests until they update.

## [1.1.3] - 2026-11-07

### Changed
- The number on the GF minimap button is now green, like the online dots in the list, instead of red. It counts guildmates online with GuildForge (you included), and the red looked like unread notifications. Hover the button to see who they are.

## [1.1.2] - 2026-11-06

### Added
- **Guild bank materials** with the Guild Bank Toons addon (optional). When it's installed and your guild has a bank toon or shared guild bank tab, reagent lines show how many the guild bank has (`Guild bank: 120`), and:
  - **Get mats from guild bank** on an expanded recipe asks the bank for what your bags are missing, for as many as are on your shopping list (or one). The Shopping List has the same button for every material still needed.
  - **Craft order via guild bank** on a recipe you don't know has the bank mail the missing materials straight to the crafter GuildForge would ask, and whispers them as usual, saying the mats are coming from the guild bank.
  - The buttons are greyed out, with the reason in their tooltip, when the bank has none of what's missing. Chat tells you what was requested and anything the bank couldn't cover.
  - Without Guild Bank Toons, or in a guild without a bank, none of this shows. It appears as soon as a bank is set up, without a reload.

### Fixed
- The GF minimap button sat on a different ring from other addons' buttons, so it looked pushed into the map. It now uses the same spacing and size as other minimap buttons (those made with LibDBIcon), and follows square minimaps too.

## [1.1.1] - 2026-11-05

### Added
- **Discord bot** (`companion/`, not part of the addon download): a crafting leaderboard that stays up to date in one message, plus `/levels`, `/crafts` and `/leaderboard` commands whose answers only the asker sees and that delete themselves. See the README for setup.

### Fixed
- **Ordinary recipes showed up as cooldowns on WoW Forever** ("20 of 20 ready"). Right after you craft, Forever reports a few seconds of cooldown on every recipe, and GuildForge took each one for a profession cooldown and shared it. Only cooldowns of a minute or more count now, those wrong entries are cleared once, and ones still sent by older versions are ignored. A real cooldown that was already ready (like Mooncloth) shows again the next time it's used.

## [1.1.0] - 2026-11-05

### Added
- **Message log window.** Settings → **Message log** (or `/gf log`) shows everything GuildForge sends and receives, live, plus its chat messages, with times. **Copy** puts it, with your version, game client and name at the top, in a box ready to paste into Discord or a GitHub issue. **Clear** starts it fresh. It keeps the last 500 lines.

### Note
- Everyone should update: 1.1.0 and older versions don't exchange the Not known in guild list.

## [1.0.9] - 2026-11-04

### Fixed
- **Some guildmates on WoW Forever still couldn't see each other** and showed as "version unknown" in `/gf who`. When two characters report different realms, the game adds the realm to the other's name on messages and in the guild roster ("First-Surname-CAMWOWUS2Realm2PvE"), so the names didn't match. GuildForge now reads a Forever name as just the first name and surname. Guildmates still on 1.0.7 are understood too.
- On WoW Forever, messages that wait out an instance or combat no longer pile up: they're dropped while blocked, and GuildForge checks in with the guild as soon as you're out, so everything catches up.
- **Recipes weren't shared when opening a profession on WoW Forever.** Forever's profession window opens before its recipe list loads, so GuildForge read an empty list. It now looks again once the recipes have loaded.

### Changed
- `/gf debug` now also shows whether GuildForge is set up to receive guild messages and how many addon messages have arrived, and message text in it displays correctly. It also lists each saved guildmate's professions and recipe counts, and the summary you share.
- `/gf scan` (with a profession window open) shows what GuildForge can read from the window and saves your recipes.
